import sys, time
import calc

# The suite is slow on purpose: each group takes about eight seconds.
GROUPS = [
    ("mean", lambda: calc.mean([2, 4, 6, 8]) == 5),
    ("median of odd count", lambda: calc.median([7, 1, 3]) == 3),
    ("median of even count", lambda: calc.median([4, 1, 3, 2]) == 2.5),
]
failed = []
for name, check in GROUPS:
    time.sleep(8)
    ok = check()
    print(("ok   " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, flush=True)
    if not ok:
        failed.append(name)
print("ALL PASSED" if not failed else f"{len(failed)} FAILED", flush=True)
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
